scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: The discovery club
scenes.caption: Kabir sees a pretend shop offering a club kit at a surprising discount. Its page has neat photographs and many follower icons. Meera asks which information comes from outside the seller’s own page and whether an adult has reviewed the offer.
scenes.speech: Kabir sees a pretend shop offering a club kit at a surprising discount. Its page has neat photographs and many follower icons. Meera asks which information comes from outside the seller’s own page and whether an adult has reviewed the offer.

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: A problem to solve
scenes.caption: Attractive pictures can be copied, and popularity is not a guarantee of delivery or honest terms. A seller’s own statement is still a claim. The class compares source cards rather than searching for real sellers, contacting strangers or making any payment during the lesson.
scenes.speech: Attractive pictures can be copied, and popularity is not a guarantee of delivery or honest terms. A seller’s own statement is still a claim. The class compares source cards rather than searching for real sellers, contacting strangers or making any payment during the lesson.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: Try the idea
scenes.caption: One independent card says the kit’s contents differ from the advertisement. Another card gives no information about delivery. The team records the conflict and unknowns, then asks an adult to decide whether further checking is appropriate. Missing evidence is not repaired by excitement about a discount.
scenes.speech: One independent card says the kit’s contents differ from the advertisement. Another card gives no information about delivery. The team records the conflict and unknowns, then asks an adult to decide whether further checking is appropriate. Missing evidence is not repaired by excitement about a discount.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: Choose and explain
scenes.caption: All photos and follower counts are on the seller’s page. The supplied independent card conflicts with the advertised contents. Compare the actions, then inspect the explanation before moving on.
scenes.speech: All photos and follower counts are on the seller’s page. The supplied independent card conflicts with the advertised contents. Compare the actions, then inspect the explanation before moving on.
scenes.dialogue: Do the photos and followers prove the kit will arrive as promised?

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: See the consequence
scenes.caption: No. Record the conflicting evidence and ask a responsible adult before any purchase. The page’s appearance does not resolve the unanswered questions about the offer.
scenes.speech: No. Record the conflicting evidence and ask a responsible adult before any purchase. The page’s appearance does not resolve the unanswered questions about the offer.
scenes.dialogue: Distinguish independent review from seller-controlled text.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: Your turn in the lab
scenes.caption: Now open the practice lab. Work through seller claims, then independent evidence, then an adult-led decision. Test each answer, read feedback and try again when needed. Save your evidence and explain one decision in your own words.

scenes.dialogue: Why can a polished page still leave important questions unanswered?
